request_state.title: Kraus Sieve Extension to p in [2201, 2300]
request_state.text: Algorithmic Kraus sieve with auxiliary primes q = 2kp + 1 eliminates all non-trivial primitive solutions to A^3 + B^3 = C^p for all primes p in [2201, 2300].

relevance.instructions: How directly does this candidate bear on resolving Beal conjecture for three independent exponents x, y, z >= 3?
criteria: level 1: modular method on one signature with no new structural input
level 2: settles bounded exponents or requires fixing one exponent
level 3: provides a uniform mechanism across all three exponents x, y, z >= 3
level 4: completely proves or disproves Beal conjecture

obstruction_risk.instructions: What is the risk that this line of attack hits a known project obstruction (e.g. residual/isogeny conflation, unbounded Selmer rank, or ineffective height)?
criteria: level 0: minimal risk; fully effective tools available
level 1: requires proving effectivity of known qualitative theorems
level 2: depends on deep open conjectures (e.g. Tate-Shafarevich finiteness or Vojta)
level 3: provably blocked by structural barriers

recommended_action.instructions: What single next action should this candidate receive from the research loop right now?
